name: Anniestylez_Media
headline: I turn Brands
statement: AI Video Creator & Editor creating bold, story-led videos for brands, products and people who want to be experienced not just watched.
about: I take an idea from the first spark to a finished piece of video. I turn real problems into creative stories that make people see themselves, understand the problem, and recognise the brand as the solution. The goal is simple: connect with both problem-aware and solution-aware viewers, then make them want what your brand offers.
services: Turning a brief, product or rough idea into a clear visual concept with a strong creative direction.
Building original visual sequences and complete videos designed around the story, audience and objective.
Shaping footage, visuals, sound and pacing into a polished final piece that feels deliberate and engaging.
Short, memorable advertising videos made to communicate value quickly and leave an impression.
Fast-moving social content built around hooks, retention, clarity and a reason to keep watching.
Creating a visual language that helps ideas, brands and stories connect without overcomplicating the message.
End-to-end support for turning a content idea into something ready to publish and share.
Keeping the visual idea, narrative and final execution aligned from the first frame to the last.

projects.title: Real Estate Campaign
projects.description:
NITTY HOMES.

A cinematic AI-powered concept created to show how NITTY HOMES can make house hunting in Lagos simpler, more transparent, and less stressful.

The story takes the viewer through the entire journey, from searching for a home and filtering suitable properties to physical inspection, live video viewing, agreement, and finally moving into the new home.

The goal was simple: make the problem feel familiar, then position NITTY HOMES as the solution.

Concept Development  AI Video Production  Storytelling  Editing  Creative Direction

projects.title: Construction Technology
projects.description:
QENVORA PROJECTS.

A cinematic AI-powered concept created to introduce Qenvora Projects and its approach to construction planning.

The story follows a homeowner from the uncertainty of traditional construction to a new way of experiencing a home before construction begins. Using full-scale holographic visualization on the actual property, the homeowner can walk through the proposed design, identify changes, and approve the final vision before committing to construction.

The goal was to communicate a simple idea: you shouldn't have to wait until your home is built to discover whether you got it right.

Concept Development  AI Video Production  Storytelling  Creative Direction  Editing

projects.title: Academic Campaign
projects.description:
NORVERIA ACADEMY

A cinematic AI-powered concept created for a school campaign focused on curiosity, technology, character, and future readiness.

The story begins with a simple childhood moment: a curious boy exploring his mother's phone. That curiosity becomes the foundation for a larger conversation about raising children in a world where technology is advancing rapidly, while wisdom, discernment, and character remain just as important.

The campaign positions the school as more than a place for academic success. Through twice-yearly seminars featuring professionals and thought leaders across AI, research, vocational skills, financial literacy, entrepreneurship, and technology, the school aims to expose students to the world they are preparing to enter.

The core message is simple: don't suppress a child's curiosity. Give it direction.

Concept Development  AI Video Production  Storytelling  Creative Direction  Editing
